name: Chathurmukha Brahma Lingeswara Swamy Temple

location.address: Chebrolu, Guntur District, Andhra Pradesh 522212, India

history.summary: The Government of Andhra Pradesh Guntur District portal identifies the Chathurmukha Brahma Lingeswara Swamy Temple at Chebrolu. Historical census material also records older temple traditions at Chebrolu, including Mahaseva and Kumaraswamy worship, while a state-protected-monument listing identifies a Chathurmukha Brahma temple at Chebrolu.
history.founding_period: 13th century A.D. in the state-protected-monument listing; chronology should be treated as provisional until checked against the underlying government monument register

name_origin.summary: The name Chathurmukha Brahma refers to Brahma's four-faced form; the association with the Lingeswara shrine is reflected in the temple's commonly used name.

features: Temple complex associated with Chebrolu's protected historic temple group
